label: Week 39, 2026
recap:
Week 39, 2026 was quiet, with two bill movements across two jurisdictions. California recorded one movement, and the District of Columbia recorded one. The activity touched three themes, each once: health care, infrastructure and energy, and transparency and disclosure. No unthemed bills appeared.

Case updates totaled three, while federal documents were absent. The California movement involved infrastructure and energy and transparency and disclosure, and the District of Columbia movement involved health care. These counts describe a narrow week of state and district level attention to AI in clinical settings, energy costs, and disclosure duties.
